system.description: Touching a standing body of water and spending two Willpower Traits, you spend Mental Traits to raise a watery barrier, each Trait creating 10 feet of wall in width or height, up to your permanent Mental Traits as a limit. The wall must be placed in a straight line within your sight and lasts until sunrise; it cannot be climbed but can be flown over. Anyone attempting to pass through must win three Static Physical Challenges against your permanent Mental Traits.
